query: I have a 44-year-old male; among males 39–49 in the ICU, what's the minimum respiratory rate in first 24 hours?
final_sql:
SELECT
  MIN(ce.valuenum) AS min_respiratory_rate
FROM
  physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients p
JOIN
  physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays icu
  ON p.subject_id = icu.subject_id
JOIN
  physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents ce
  ON icu.stay_id = ce.stay_id
JOIN
  physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items di
  ON ce.itemid = di.itemid
WHERE
  p.gender = 'M'
  AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 39 AND 49
  AND di.label = 'Respiratory Rate'
  AND ce.valuenum IS NOT NULL
  AND ce.charttime IS NOT NULL
  AND ce.charttime BETWEEN icu.intime AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(icu.intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR);
